description: No charge. Public standard fixed-price quote from mailClass, pageCount and recipientCount; use recipientCount:1 for a single letter or postcard (mailClass:postcard, pageCount:1); no artwork inspection or sending. Optional couponCode is validated server-side. Returns payment rails and live x402 assets.

couponCode.description: Server-validated catalog code (case-insensitive). Applied to charged/quoted cents only — staging keys still never buy postage. Unknown codes are rejected.
